issues.description: Field 'numberOfLecturers' in class Lecture has conflicting types: the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares numberOfLecturers as int (line 67), while the solution implementation declares the field as byte (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 9) and the Lecture constructor parameter uses byte (line 13). This inconsistency confuses students about the intended type and the correct constructor/signature and setter/getter types.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfLecturers consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution implementation to use int for the field, the constructor parameter, the getter return type and the setter parameter (update lines where 'byte numberOfLecturers' appears to 'int numberOfLecturers'). Alternative: update the problem statement/UML to specify byte and adjust the template and tests accordingly — but prefer int to match the UML and avoid surprising students with a narrower integer type.
